verdict.rationale: The official overview explicitly lists all four tasks as things Claude Code handles: writing tests for untested code, fixing lint errors across a project, resolving merge conflicts, and updating dependencies (claude-code-docs-20). Supporting docs show it running tests in its workflow, running lint via hooks, and scheduling weekly dependency audits. Community reports of general unreliability do not concretely contradict these specific tasks, so they lower confidence rather than the verdict. Missing for 10: in-depth per-task documentation (the four tasks appear only as a one-line list), and independent or hands-on corroboration of merge-conflict resolution and dependency updates specifically.
